semantics_contract.policy: No P Q means not exists x (P(x) and Q(x)), without existential import. Noun-head then surface modifier then matrix predicate order. Person, young, ugly, handsome, teach, extraterrestrial and human are extensional properties evaluated in the utterance context; no degree/time elimination, generic closure or lexical nonhuman axiom. Teaches is a standing current-context teaching property, not a newly asserted teaching event.

notes: Hand-authored before producer observation. The whole negated existential is Asserted; every restriction and matrix atom is Embedded.
